title: One thing at a time — новые слова

items.example: My friend is a typical multi-tasker.

items.translation: тот, кто делает несколько дел сразу
items.example: Multi-taskers do less work in an eight-hour day.
It's easy: do one thing at a time.
In one hour she answered three text messages.
She answered three text messages in one hour.
He checked his email and ordered his food.
We ordered our food and then paid for it.
She ordered her food, ate it and paid for it.
We had two short phone conversations.
Turn your phone off — let's talk and listen.
We exchanged phone numbers after lunch.
When you multi-task you forget names and numbers.
You can't remember normal things easily.
When you multi-task, your stress levels go up.
You can't remember your bank PIN number.
You don't listen to them carefully.
Always have music? No — he listens quietly.
